note: Glaze 1.0.40: every theme now has five different artworks, and choosing a theme is one simple step. New art for 37 themes, including four new pieces each for Deep Sea, Starry Night and Sunset Dunes, so no theme repeats a piece. Tap a theme and answer Use this theme? It goes on your widgets straight away: the Widgets tab shows Preparing, then that theme's own Artwork 1-5, with no need for Use everything or a Home Screen widget first. Downloaded themes are fetched before they are applied, and art follows as soon as a theme finishes downloading. Then a short list of next steps: Add the wallpaper, View icons and View widgets, which opens the Widgets tab. A slot never shows the same artwork twice. Each artwork has a menu to Save to Photos or Add to Custom 1-5. Live widget pickers (clocks, countdown, battery, steps) and the separate theme widgets screen are hidden for now; widgets already on your Home Screen keep working.
